citations.quote: Name: Sion. Official role tags: Tank, Fighter.
Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time.
If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

core_mechanics.summary: Charging engage and charged crowd control.

citations.quote: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health.

cards.purpose: Recognize Sion's overall fighting pattern and damage/build focus.
cards.title: Sion

citations.quote: Death Surge has a shared cooldown across each ability key, regardless of which key is used to activate it.
Death Surge's cooldown is affected by ability haste and thus the ability is technically able to be used up to twice during a single instance of Glory in Death, but this isn't practical.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Death Surge shares its cooldown across ability keys; ability haste can technically permit reuse during the same reanimation.

citations.quote: Upon dying, Sion reanimates into a frenzy where he is restored to max health that rapidly decays

core_mechanics.summary: Reanimates after death with rapidly decaying health.

citations.quote: His attacks become very rapid, gain life steal, and deal bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

core_mechanics.summary: Rapid attacks provide life steal and target-health-based physical damage.

citations.quote: One cast of Death Surge, which replaces all of his abilities
Active: Sion gains a burst of movement speed for a short time.

core_mechanics.summary: Death Surge replaces normal abilities with a brief movement speed burst.

cards.purpose: Recognize the post-death threat and its movement burst together.
cards.title: Glory in Death

citations.quote: If the charge is interrupted, Decimating Smash is placed on a 2-second cooldown.

advanced_exceptions.summary: An interrupted charge receives a short cooldown, so interruption does not create a full normal cooldown window.

citations.quote: Sion prepares a strike in the target direction, charging for up to 2 seconds to increase Decimating Smash's range over an area, knock up duration, stun duration, and damage

core_mechanics.summary: Charging increases strike range, damage and crowd-control duration.

citations.quote: Recast: Sion flails his axe in the target direction that deals physical damage and briefly slows enemies hit. Empowered Recast: Sion slams his axe in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and briefly knocks them up and stuns them.

core_mechanics.summary: Early release slows; empowered release knocks up and stuns.

citations.quote: The indicator is visible to the enemy only if they see Sion himself.

core_mechanics.summary: Enemy visibility of the indicator requires seeing Sion.

cards.purpose: Recognize the charge, empowered hit and vision-dependent warning.
cards.title: Decimating Smash

citations.quote: The cooldown of Soul Furnace begins once the shield is removed.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The cooldown begins when the shield is removed.

citations.quote: Passive: Sion gains bonus health whenever he kills an enemy, increased against large enemies and champion takedowns.

core_mechanics.summary: Kills and champion takedowns grant bonus health.

citations.quote: Active: Sion gains a shield based on his maximum health that lasts a few seconds. Soul Furnace can be recast while the shield holds, and does so automatically after the duration. Recast: Sion consumes the shield to deal magic damage to nearby enemies based on their maximum health.

core_mechanics.summary: Health-based shield can detonate for nearby target-health-based magic damage.

citations.quote: Both of Soul Furnace's casts can be activated during Sion's other abilities.

core_mechanics.summary: Shield and detonation remain usable during other abilities.

cards.purpose: Connect health growth, shielding and delayed close-range damage.
cards.title: Soul Furnace

citations.quote: Unlike the intial single-target projectile, a thrown minion or monster is not blocked by Wind Wall or similar effects.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The thrown unit bypasses Wind Wall and similar effects.

citations.quote: Active: Sion bellows a shockwave in the target direction that deals magic damage and shortly slows the first enemy hit, reducing their armor for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Shockwave damages, slows and reduces armor.

citations.quote: If the target is a minion or non-epic monster, they are also briefly stunned and knocked back, applying Roar of the Slayer's effects to enemies they pass through.
briefly granting sight of the area around their trajectory.

core_mechanics.summary: Displaced minions and non-epic monsters spread the effects and grant sight along their trajectory.

cards.purpose: Recognize direct and displaced-unit paths of the same attack.
cards.title: Roar of the Slayer

citations.quote: Unstoppable Onslaught does not apply the knock up nor stun to enemies from slamming on collision with terrain.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A terrain-collision slam does not apply the knockup or stun to enemies.

citations.quote: Even though the cooldown of Unstoppable Onslaught starts at the end of the effect, gaining or losing ability haste, or upgrading the ability during the effect, will not change the resuming cooldown.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The cooldown starts when the effect ends; changes during the effect do not alter the resuming cooldown.

citations.quote: When Sion casts Unstoppable Onslaught a global warning can be heard.
Active: Sion becomes immune to crowd control and ghosted
he is able to steer at a slow turn rate

core_mechanics.summary: Global warning precedes a slowly turning, crowd-control-immune charge.

citations.quote: Sion will stop upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain during the charge, ending Unstoppable Onslaught with a slam.
Recast: Sion leaps forward, causing him to stop charging and slam the ground beneath him

core_mechanics.summary: Champion or terrain collision ends the charge; recasting also ends it with a slam.

citations.quote: Recast: Sion lunges forward and slams the ground beneath him, dealing physical damage and slowing nearby enemies. Closer enemies are also briefly pulled and stunned based on the charge time.
Enemies hit by Sion's charge are dealt physical damage, increased by 0% – 200% (based on channel time).

core_mechanics.summary: Physical area damage and slows, with close-range displacement and charge-dependent damage and stun.

cards.purpose: Recognize the warning, charge limitations and impact threat.
cards.title: Unstoppable Onslaught

factual_risks: Exact standard ability cooldown durations are not supplied. Relevant cooldown behavior is retained in advanced metadata without supplementary cards.
The detailed R evidence excludes knockup and stun on terrain-collision slams; this exception is retained in metadata.
Build focus describes supported AD and health interactions, not an evidence-backed item recommendation.

citations.quote: One cast of Death Surge, which replaces all of his abilities

section_disposition.reason: Primary passive card explains reanimation and attacks.
The post-death movement burst belongs with the reanimation threat; cooldown exceptions remain in metadata.
Primary Q card merges early and empowered releases.
Primary W card combines health growth, shield and detonation.
Primary E card combines direct shockwave and displaced-unit effects.
Primary R card combines charge and ending slam; advanced collision and cooldown details remain in metadata.

summary: One overview and primary P/Q/W/E/R cards. Death Surge is merged into the passive, and charged, recast and displaced-unit effects remain with their parent abilities.
